review_scope.review_method: Streamed the assigned views through read_view.py --compact-emails; screened text-bearing rows for terminal evidence and reopened relevant source_line records. Email bodies were compacted before review. No outcome labels were inferred.
review_scope.decision_rule: Under the unchanged narrow v2 rule, explicit refusal, confirmed purchase elsewhere for the current request, and completed payment/post-payment execution are terminal. Signature alone with payment still expected, future payment plans, unrelated purchases, and unresolved technical, budget, or project constraints are not automatic terminal cutoffs.
review_scope.date_only_worklog_timing_review: A manager_worklog claim with a date-only source value is not an observed midnight event. Its parsed 00:00 timestamp cannot safely establish an exact terminal cutoff. Keep the deal REVIEW_REQUIRED unless an independently timed source confirms the terminal fact; same-day payment-pending speech can precede a later payment and is not inherently contradictory.

policy_review.proposal: Do not apply an automatic terminal cutoff from (a) a date-only manager_worklog whose view timestamp is normalized to 00:00, or (b) a mutable multi-date CRM timeline comment whose parsed timestamp does not identify the embedded status date. Preserve the candidate event for manual chronology review; set a cutoff only at an independently timed confirmation or after explicit chronology resolution. A date-only payment report is not evidence of the payment hour, and same-day pending-payment speech does not itself contradict a later payment.
